description: Returns the endpoint, price and payment method of the optional paid hosted check. It does not call the API and does not pay or sign anything. The paid check covers what check_crypto_link cannot see offline: domain registration age (RDAP), DNS resolution, the redirect chain, and one fetch of the page scanned for seed-phrase prompts and token-approval drainer code. It accepts 1-10 URLs per call for 0.005 USDC on Base via x402. Use it when check_crypto_link returns no_red_flags or caution for a link that someone is about to trust with a wallet and you want more evidence. If check_crypto_link already says dangerous or official, you usually do not need it. Returns: method, url_template, price_usdc, network, asset, protocol, max_urls, settles and docs.
name: full_report_info
title: How to buy the full hosted link check
